answer: Unannounced live skill drills stop Sybils in four steps. First, a newcomer posts a $25 bond and a response window, promising reachability. Second, the network fires a live drill at a random hour: a small real task due in 15 minutes, like a beacon on a mesa at night. Third, three blind peers grade it; two failures burn the bond and freeze the key ninety days. Fourth, twenty passed drills unlock full limits. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 people on call 24/7, $120,000 a day at $5 an hour, all lost when caught. Like a pearl diver surfacing at the whistle, only the truly present get paid.
